Bihar MLC Election Results 2026:JDU men ekshan ki taiyari! anant ke bad ab kiski bari?| JDU| Bihar News
MLC chunav ke natije aa chuke hain...aur sabse hot sit rahi patna snatak par JDU ke ummidvar niraj kumar ne ek bar phir jit darj kar li hai...aur is jit ke bad ab anant sinh ko lekar parti ke rashtriy karyakari adhyaksh sanjay jha ne bara bayan diya hai...unhonne kaha, ki parti men anushasan ka palan nahin karne valon par har hal men karravaee ki jaegi...saval hai ki ye karravaee kya anant sinh tak rukegi..ya iski jad men koee aur bhi aane vala hai...
